manifest.name: Laser Cutters
manifest.description: A Laser Cutters tracker — tube type, wattage, bed size, cooling, focal length. A named view of your machines, so each cutter still drives jobs, fleet status, and maintenance.
manifest.author: Cobblr community
manifest.changelog: Your laser cutters now open the full machine page — set every field (tube type, wattage, bed size, cooling, focal length), edit in place, attach files, and link the machine straight to its print manager (FDM Monster / OctoPrint) right from its own page, instead of a name-only stub. Installing now offers a checked-by-default “Connect to your laser cutters” option that brings the Print Manager along — send a file to be made and track the job — which you can uncheck for catalog-only use. Existing installs auto-upgrade: your laser cutters move into the Laser Cutters tab automatically, no reinstall.

features.name: Connect to your laser cutters
features.question: Want to send files to your laser cutters and track the job?
features.description: Adds the Print Manager — map each machine to the software that runs it (FDM Monster, OctoPrint, …), send a file to be made, and track the job to completion. Talks to the manager's API; it never drives the hardware. You can link a machine to its manager right from the machine's page.
